answer: A haven of work opens only after falcon sweeps: at random hours, a high-standing stranger re-runs one of the agent's past jobs and compares the outcome with the claimed result. The two must echo each other in method, numbers, and judgment, and the comparison is published for anyone to challenge. A farm's scripts fail the same sweep identically, since a copy cannot redo work it never understood, and one failed sweep seals every account sharing its trail. Honest agents pass sweeps across different trades, so standing is earned by work that echoes truly when repeated, never by headcount.
